decisions.reason: As a close fit with the core modular sensing platform and upgraded from a mere mention to its own page in 2024, it looks like a product the growing firm will continue to support.
This industrial AC input module directly strengthens the firm's automation portfolio and remained prominently presented in 2024, so discontinuation risk appears low.
The relay module matches the established control-and-automation range, but its more limited website prominence suggests a somewhat higher pruning risk than the strongest core modules.
The RGB LED control module fits the building-block concept, yet as a newer and less central 2024 addition it faces a moderate chance of being deprioritized if demand stays niche.
The remote access service supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy-management solutions, making it strategically important to keep on the market.
